status: fixed-particle prototype; closure assumptions are not Mars chamber measurements

lookup_coverage.source: NASA Ames Mars GCM v3.2.1 dry-mixture CO2/H2O tables, staged in framework/physics/ames_co2_12band.npz
lookup_coverage.classification: interpolation coverage, not physical model validation; out-of-domain values are rejected, not clamped
lookup_coverage.loading_policy: no evidence-backed universal numerical threshold; optional caller-selected criterion, dilute backreaction omission remains unvalidated

solar_weighting.classification: nominal solar effective temperature; blackbody within-band spectrum remains an approximation

model_assumptions.scope: flat homogeneous screening experiment, not a source-validated Mars climatology
model_assumptions.climate: flat terrain, emissivity 1, uniform configured albedo and initial temperature/pressure; spinup duration alone does not establish equilibration
model_assumptions.gas: staged dry CO2-dominated opacity mixture; composition evolution, atmospheric CO2 condensation and cloud feedbacks are not validated
model_assumptions.optics: random-orientation monomer spectra, source-constant continuation beyond 55 um, temperature-independent optical constants; only Planck weighting changes with temperature
model_assumptions.radiative_transfer: plane-parallel two-stream angular closure; no spherical twilight geometry or supplied full rod phase function; numerical conservation does not establish angular accuracy
model_assumptions.mobility: continuum rod and Epstein limiting laws joined by a harmonic resistance approximation; diffuse-reflection accommodation is an idealized limiting case, not a measured rod property
model_assumptions.particle_feedback: dilute, gas-equilibrated release; gas displacement, drag backreaction and industrial plume energy/momentum are omitted; no validated loading cutoff
model_assumptions.aggregation: disabled in active runs without aggregate spectra; optional passive compact/fractal morphology is a sensitivity scenario, not measured mobility
model_assumptions.numerics: spectral positivity limiter redistributes material; gas projection changes energy; both are diagnosed, not physical closures
model_assumptions.accuracy: dt, grid, damping and error tolerances are numerical choices requiring refinement; passing checks is not scientific acceptance
model_assumptions.references: 4 K/35 K source outcomes and an assumed one-year lifetime are comparison curves, not fitted targets or imposed GCM removal

co2_viscosity.source: COMSOL CFD Module User's Guide, High Mach Number Flow, Sutherland's Law, carbon dioxide material row
co2_viscosity.classification: engineering gas-property approximation; validate sensitivity over the declared Mars domain

continuum_rod_drag.source: Tirado, Martinez and Garcia de la Torre (1984), DOI 10.1063/1.447827
continuum_rod_drag.classification: random-orientation continuum cylinder mobility applied to the source's square-section rod

free_molecular_drag.source: Epstein (1924), DOI 10.1103/PhysRev.23.710; random convex-body projected area
free_molecular_drag.classification: projected-area rod extension and harmonic transition interpolation are explicit sensitivity closures

aggregation.source: Roadmap arXiv:2604.02242 Appendix A; Seinfeld and Pandis (2016)
aggregation.convention: binary collision kernel K; identical-particle number loss dN/dt=-K*N^2/2
aggregation.aggregate_shape: compact volume-radius scaling is a screening assumption
aggregation.radiative_gate: monomer spectra are not aggregate spectra; active aggregation requires supplied validated aggregate optics

years: SI seconds internally. The roadmap's unqualified lifetime year is not silently assigned an Earth/Mars duration.
missing_data: Mars particle sticking and charge distributions
photophoretic force laws and surface re-loft thresholds

upstream_reference.use: architectural reference; kernels here are independently implemented for Mars and do not copy upstream Earth defaults
